package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
)

type telegramLinkIssuer interface {
	IssueLinkCode(context.Context, string) (domain.TelegramLinkCode, error)
}

type TelegramChannelHandler struct {
	Links   telegramLinkIssuer
	Enabled bool
}

func (handler TelegramChannelHandler) IssueLinkCode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	if !handler.Enabled || handler.Links == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "telegram channel unavailable")
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1024))
	if err != nil || (strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) != "" && strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) != "{}") {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "request body must be empty")
		return
	}
	link, err := handler.Links.IssueLinkCode(r.Context(), studentID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, link)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "telegram channel unavailable")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to create telegram link")
	}
}
